title: tooling(ui-wiring): objectstack-side inert wiring for the `ui/` workspace — workspace globs, root turbo tasks, path-filtered ui test/typecheck/lint/E2E jobs, spec change compiles the Console; pin gates retire at cutover (parent #25677, 3/6)
body:
Filing gate ④: sub-issue 3/6 of the epic #25677 (`pm:epic`; epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`). Part of #25677. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: none for PR A — nothing in it needs a change from #25685, everything it adds is inert while `ui/` is absent, and it is verified against a throwaway import (below). PR B is drafted here but merges only in the cutover window (sub-issue 5), right after the subtree PR.

**Who does it, where it lands:** the epic PM dispatches it (os-dev, objectstack checkout). Two PRs to **objectstack-ai/objectstack `main`**. Both touch `.github/workflows/**`, so both are **Tier H**: draft until CI is green, the maintainer approves and merges, the seat never enqueues them. Why two PRs: PR A can land weeks before cutover and is exercised on every PR without effect; PR B deletes the two-repo pin gates and is only correct from the moment `ui/` exists, so it is drafted now and merged in the freeze window.

## 维护者速读

子卡 1 的 spike 证明，`ui/` 接进来后 objectstack 这边要做的只有三类事：pnpm workspace 认得 `ui/` 下的包、根 `turbo.json` 认得 objectui 的任务名、CI 给 ui 开按 `ui/**` 路径过滤的测试/类型检查/lint/Playwright 作业，并在 spec 改动的 PR 里直接编译 Console（这正是今天 Spec Shape Gate 每小时对着 clone 做 13 分钟的事，合并后同一次 CI 顺手做掉）。这些都能在 `ui/` 还不存在时先落 main：目录不在，通配匹配不到任何包，新作业全部跳过。切换日再合第二个 PR：删 Spec Shape Gate、Console Pin Gate、prerelease-pin-watch 和 `.objectui-sha` 过滤。两个 PR 都碰 `.github/workflows/**`，按 Tier H 由维护者批准、人工合并。

## Scope

**PR A — inert wiring, lands before cutover**

1. **Workspace.** `pnpm-workspace.yaml` adds `ui`, `ui/packages/*`, `ui/apps/*`, `ui/examples/*` to `packages:` and the union of objectui's `onlyBuiltDependencies`. Verified 2026-10-24: pnpm 10.28 accepts globs that match nothing — `pnpm install` and `pnpm -r ls` are unchanged. NOT moved here: objectui's `pnpm.overrides` (security floors for `qs`, `shell-quote`, `tmp`, `uuid`, the react 19.3.0 line) and the `@radix-ui/react-focus-scope@1.1.16` patch — an unused `patchedDependencies` entry fails install and an override rewrites today's lockfile. Those travel with the subtree in sub-issue 5; the spike's `ec74d9ecfa` / `4f3149d015` on `claude/project-thread-dwhq6r` are the recipe.
2. **Root turbo.** `turbo.json` absorbs the four task names objectui's packages use and the root lacks — `type-check`, `lint`, `test:dist`, `test:watch` — with the inputs/outputs/dependsOn objectui's `turbo.json` declares for them (read it at `ui/turbo.objectui.json` on the spike branch; the spike parked it because turbo 2.11 rejects a nested `turbo.json` without `extends`, finding 7). Its `globalDependencies` (`.objectstack-sha`, the shape-gate stamp, the stamp cache) are pin plumbing and are not ported. A task defined for a script no objectstack package has is inert; the dev proves `turbo run build --dry=json` on `main` lists the same tasks before and after.
3. **CI jobs for `ui/**`.** In `ci.yml`: a `ui` output on the `filter` job (`ui/**`), and jobs `Test UI (n/N)` (objectui's vitest projects partitioned by package, N chosen from measured timings the way `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` does for core — objectui runs 16 shards today), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI` (or in `lint.yml`, wherever the existing split puts it) and `Build & E2E UI` (Console build + Playwright, objectui `ci.yml`'s `Build & E2E` job ported; Node heap per #25685 item 4). Every new job is guarded by BOTH the filter output AND `hashFiles('ui/package.json') != ''`, because the filter's "everything changed" fallback on push (`|| 'true'`, THE FILTER CONTRACT #4928) would otherwise start them on a tree without `ui/`. None joins the required set until cutover (the ruleset is the maintainer's, sub-issue 5); `required-set-patrol` and `check:shard-attestation` must keep passing with the new jobs skipped.
4. **A spec change compiles the Console.** `Type Check UI` also runs when any of the seven packages objectui installs changes (`packages/spec`, `client`, `core`, `formula`, `lint`, `sdui-parser`, `types`), so the compile Spec Shape Gate does hourly against a clone of objectui `main` happens in the PR that moves the shape, naming the `ui/` file. The dev reports the measured cold and turbo-warm minutes against today's ~13 min hourly gate.
5. **Roster audit.** A table over objectui's 28 workflows — "ported in PR A / already covered by an objectstack workflow / dropped", one line each — posted on this card. Correctness gates (`ci`, `lint`, `live-e2e`, `performance-budget`, `published-dist-gate`, `node-esm-load-gate`, `shadcn-check`, `lockfile-dedupe`, `lockfile-integrity`, `spec-range-floors`) are decided and, where kept, ported in this card; governance workflows (`changeset-*`, `governed-surface-guard`, `half-state-patrol`, `merge-queue-head-patrol`, `required-check-set-patrol`, `board-snapshot`, `labeler`, `line-citation-gate`, `hook-selftests`, `repo-gates`, `test-shard-timings-refresh`, `cross-repo-issue-closer`, `dependabot-auto-merge`, `docs-deploy`, `check-links`, `changelog`) go to sub-issue 4 with the table as its input.

**PR B — retire the two-repo pin gates, drafted now, merged in the cutover window after the subtree PR**

6. Delete `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml` with `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs` and `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json`; delete the `console-pin` job (Console Pin Gate) and the `console` entries of the `filter` job; delete `.github/workflows/prerelease-pin-watch.yml`; drop `Spec Shape Gate` from `RELEASE_GATE_WORKFLOWS` in `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` and from any `release.yml` / `cut-rc.yml` read of it. The scripts those jobs call (`build-console.sh`, `check-console-sha.mjs`, `check-console-injection.mjs`, `console-spec-probes.mjs`, `assert-console-spec-injection.mjs`) stay until sub-issue 4 removes them with the pin field and the `packages/console` build switch; PR B only stops the workflows from being the thing that proves the pin.

## Verification (the dev's, before each PR leaves draft)

- PR A on `main` as it is: a CI run whose job list equals today's plus the new jobs **skipped** (not failed, not required); `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` leaves `pnpm-lock.yaml` byte-identical; `turbo run build --dry=json` lists the same tasks.
- PR A with `ui/` present: a throwaway draft PR from a branch = PR A's head + `git subtree add --prefix=ui` of objectui `main` (sha from `git ls-remote`, the #25678 recipe) + the lockfile recompute, titled `DO NOT MERGE — verification run for #<this card>`, never enqueued, closed once the run is read. It must show every new job running and green, and a counter-probe: one commit that breaks a `packages/spec/src/ui` shape objectui reads turns `Type Check UI` red naming the `ui/` file, then is reverted. Link the runs on this card.
- PR B on the same throwaway branch: green with the pin gates gone and nothing else red.

## Done when

- PR A merged on `main` (maintainer, Tier H) with the two runs linked here and the roster table posted.
- PR B open as draft, green on the throwaway branch, marked `Blocked-by: sub-issue 5` in its body and handed to the cutover card.
- Spec Shape Gate's hourly run is unchanged until PR B merges — this card never weakens a gate before its replacement has run green.

**Size:** L (PR A is the bulk: ~5 jobs ported with their caches and shard plumbing). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## 风险

- CI minutes: `Build & E2E UI` and `Type Check UI` add the Console build to spec-touching PRs; the spike measured Console 2 m 01 s warm, 7 m 31 s with 72 deps cold. If the warm number does not hold under turbo remote cache, the dev reports it here before PR A leaves draft and the PM decides between path-narrowing and a nightly tier.
- Required set drift: a skipped job that a later PR accidentally lists as required blocks every PR until cutover; `required-set-patrol` covers the ruleset side, the dev adds the new job names to its expectations only as "optional until cutover".

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-24 17:30Z, objectstack 「ui workspace CI shards Playwright path filter objectui monorepo wiring」 7 hits: this epic's own #25677 / #25678 / #25685; closed #24306, #23720, #22429 (build-console and pin bumps, the mechanism this card retires); #17250 (closed decision on where pure-objectui cards live). No card wires `ui/` into this repo's CI. **New.**
